text:
incident-bot: Pager: p95 latency > 1000ms for /v1/complete across us-east-1-c. Alert fired 2026-03-15T22:07:24Z. Auto-escalation to oncall.

leah.c: Oncall here, ack. Starting data capture. Quick customer impact check?

omar.t: Support says two enterprise customers on Dedicated saw intermittent timeouts and some 504s. Tickets opened.

ben.w: Telemetry snapshot: p50 up ~2x since 21:58, p95 jump at 22:05. CPU sys time for runtime processes increased. Kpatch 5.18.14 rolled to us-east-1-c at 21:55 as part of staged rollout.

nisha.p: Kpatch included LRU and page reclaim tweaks. I flagged it in rollout notes.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: kpatch-5.18.14 applied to pool us-east-1-c batch 2 at 2026-03-15T21:55:12Z. Rollback disabled: false.

leah.c: Captured a slow trace sample for request id req_0a9f3b:```
span /v1/complete req_0a9f3b
  wait_queue_ms: 12
  kernel_block_ms: 360
  mmap_touch_ms: 180
  gpu_exec_ms: 9
  post_process_ms: 5
  total_ms: 760
```

omar.t: Kernel log excerpt from affected host host-ue1-12:```
Mar 15 22:04:58 host-ue1-12 kernel: inference_rt[22110]: minor fault 8 times in 3s
Mar 15 22:05:01 host-ue1-12 kernel: task inference_rt blocked for more than 240 seconds
```

ben.w: Perf summary aggregated across 3 affected nodes:```
# perf stat -e context-switches,page-faults,cpu-cycles --inference
context-switches: 7320
page-faults: 1140
cpu-cycles: 1.4e9
```

karim_m: Control hosts (pinned to kpatch-5.18.12) show context-switches ~1200 and page-faults ~90 in same window. Big delta.

leah.c: Live mitigation applied 22:09: pinned traffic off pool us-east-1-c to us-east-1-a/b, and disabled further kpatch rollout. Also temporarily switched affected accounts to model variant small-quantized. Latency trending down by 22:14.

nisha.p: I've started a bisect plan. Candidate commits in the kpatch address list involve lru_shrink and futex wake ordering changes. Uploading bisect artifacts to https://redwood.s3/incident-bisect/3332114444/ .

ben.w: Hypotheses in-thread:```
H1: LRU/page reclaim change in kpatch increases minor page faults and blocking during mmap touches -> evidence: elevated minor faults, mmap_touch_ms in traces -> status: likely
H2: Scheduler preemption change causes higher schedule latency (__schedule samples) -> evidence: increased context-switches, kernel blocked messages -> status: possible
H3: Runtime interaction with new kernel config leading to spin/wait path regression -> evidence: needs targeted microbench -> status: investigating
```

omar.t: I attached perf.data files to the S3 bucket and added sample request ids: req_0a9f3b, req_1c4e77, req_2b8d11 for customer comms.

leah.c: Customer impact: two enterprise Dedicated customers experienced degraded p95 and intermittent 504s for ~12 minutes; no data loss. Support will send preliminary notification; legal reviewed and ok for action comms.

ops-bot: Mitigation actions summary:```
- 22:06: isolate pool us-east-1-c from serving
- 22:09: reroute traffic to healthy pools and switch impacted accounts to quantized variant
- 22:11: pause kpatch rollout globally
- 22:14: p95 returned to normal for observed traffic
```

ben.w: Follow-ups for RCA doc: 1) Full perf.data and kernel kallsyms for hosts host-ue1-12/13/14. 2) Complete bisect log and reproduce script. 3) Microbench: mmap-heavy KV cache access pattern under kpatch vs control. 4) Draft customer timeline and postmortem.

nisha.p: Bisect note: I'm seeing regression start at commit 0a3f2 -> likely candidate touches lru_shrink. Running local repro with page-pressure harness.

omar.t: Repro plan accepted. I'll stand up a 4-node repro cluster with same kernel build and run the mmap-touch workload overnight and report.

leah.c: Assigning action owners: @nisha.p bisect, @omar.t repro and perf attachments, @ben.w perf analysis and RCA writeup, @karim_m coordinate rollback gating. I'll draft customer-facing timeline; will need final perf artifacts and sample req ids.

ben.w: Adding quick note: keep this thread as canonical incident timeline and hypothesis tracker. We'll copy into the formal RCA doc once bisect confirms root cause. :eyes:
